display_long_description:
Swing to the beat!
Forever FREE to play.

[Key Features]
• Endless Community Content
• True Standalone VR
• Customizable Playstyle
• Intuitive UI/UX
• Fun Fitness

[How to Play]
• Hit the Beats: Hit the incoming notes with your sticks to the music.
• Match the Color: Slash notes that match your stick's color.
• Match the Direction: Slash in the direction of the arrows.
• Slash Freely: Slash ball-shaped notes freely in any direction.
• Dodge: Avoid bombs and avoid hitting your head on walls.

[Caution]
• Not intended for children under the age of 13.
• Ensure you have enough play space.
• If you are sensitive to flashing lights or have a history of seizures, consult a doctor first.
• Stop playing immediately if you experience dizziness, nausea, eye strain, or other discomfort.

[Community Content Usage]
• Community content is accessed via the BeatSaver(beatsaver.com) API.
• At first launch, users are prompted to accept BeatSaver's Terms and Policies.
